mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_asset (recipe_id, group_id, uploader_id, review_status, item_id, original_url, thumbnail_url, file_type, file_size, width, height, upload_status) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{groupId}, #{uploaderId}, #{reviewStatus}, #{itemId}, #{originalUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{uploadStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM image_asset WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM image_asset WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM image_asset WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE image_asset SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT img.id AS imageId, img.original_url AS originalUrl, img.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, img.created_at AS createdAt, img.item_id AS itemId, img.review_status AS reviewStatus, it.name AS itemName, s.name AS sectionName, r.id AS recipeId, r.title AS recipeTitle, r.recipe_date AS recipeDate, u.nickname AS uploaderName FROM image_asset img INNER JOIN menu_recipe r ON r.id = img.recipe_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN menu_item it ON it.id = img.item_id AND it.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN menu_section s ON s.id = it.section_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = img.uploader_id WHERE img.group_id = #{groupId} AND img.review_status = 'pending' AND img.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY img.created_at ASC
